story.text: On top of a large {MUSHROOM} sits a blue {CATERPILLAR}, quietly smoking a long {HOOKAH}. “Who are you?” it asks. Alice hardly knows, she has {CHANGED} so many times since this morning. She tries to recite “You are {OLD}, Father William”, but it comes out all wrong. Before it crawls away, the Caterpillar tells her: one side of the mushroom will make her grow {TALLER}, the other side {SHORTER}.
story.caption: “Who are you?” said the Caterpillar
story.credit: John Tenniel, coloured for The Nursery “Alice”, 1890
